explanation: The temple that the prophet Haggai urges the people to rebuild, symbolizing God's presence among His people.
A state of greatness and honor; in this chapter it refers both to the future glory of the temple compared with Solomon's temple, as well as to God's own great majesty that will fill the place.
Divine intervention where God promises to shake heaven and earth to overthrow the power of nations and establish His eternal order.
The term used in the prophecy about the Messiah (the great stone) who will become the cornerstone of God's new temple, represented by Jesus Christ.
God's promise to bless the land with abundant growth and harvest after the people have returned to obedience to His word.
